events.title: Phil Barlow Deep Treasures EP Launch Cooroy
events.description: Phil Barlow 'Deep Treasures' EP Launch Sunday 13 September | 3pm | 13+ | BYO Deep Treasures is a collection of songs shaped by a slow and profound inner journey of healing. It is a musical passage through loss, acceptance, courage and faith. Captured raw in single-take solo-acoustic recordings, these songs hold the aliveness of the emotional transformation Phil was experiencing when they were written. They are not about perfection, they are about the raw and vulnerable human journey through relationships, trust, change, forgiveness and growth. In the cosy atmosphere of The Nook, Phil will perform the EP in its stripped-back solo-acoustic form and share some of the stories behind the songs.
